crossRefs.note: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times.…
The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen…
Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.
For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them.…
For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. So it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.
translations.bsb: For seven days the armies camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle ensued, and the Israelites struck down the Arameans—a hundred thousand foot soldiers in one day.
translations.kjv: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
translations.asv: And they encamped one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians a hundred thousand footmen in one day.
